capability.description: Deliver an evidence-producing interactive interview mission loop without duplicating mature reusable infrastructure or content assets.
constraints: Support typed reasoning and progressive assistance.
Preserve a single cross-platform application codebase.
Keep hidden evaluation material out of the client.
non_goals: Build a general-purpose learning management system.
Create a new benchmark corpus when a suitable reusable corpus exists.

searches.query: maintained open source interactive quiz interview learning framework

receipts.note: External repository discovery surface used to identify concrete runtime alternatives.

tradeoffs.fitness: Strong assessment primitives but does not match the required mobile game mission state model without substantial adaptation.
tradeoffs.license: GPL-3.0; acceptable for evaluation but would materially affect embedding decisions.
tradeoffs.security: Mature server product with a much larger attack and deployment surface than the bounded project requires.
tradeoffs.extensibility: Highly extensible but optimized around LMS concepts rather than a narrow mobile mission loop.
tradeoffs.integration_cost: High because adopting the subsystem would pull in a broad LMS architecture.
tradeoffs.performance: No blocking evidence for quiz execution itself; mobile-native interaction fit remains the material mismatch.
material_reasons: The architecture is substantially broader than the bounded capability.
The required mission-state and mobile interaction model would still need bespoke work.

tradeoffs.fitness: Fits learner-evidence semantics but does not implement the interactive mission runtime.
tradeoffs.maintenance: Owned internal system with active project-specific maintenance.
tradeoffs.license: Internal project; reuse is organizationally permitted.
tradeoffs.security: Reuse keeps learner-state authority centralized instead of duplicating state.
tradeoffs.extensibility: Can receive bounded evidence through an adapter.
tradeoffs.integration_cost: Moderate adapter work, lower than inventing a second learner model.
tradeoffs.performance: Not on the interactive rendering hot path.
material_reasons: Provides only partial coverage, so a mission runtime is still required.

tradeoffs.fitness: Provides reusable retrieval/query material for bounded dataset-backed missions but is not itself an interview curriculum.
tradeoffs.maintenance: Widely mirrored and documented public dataset.
tradeoffs.license: Must be rechecked and pinned before production use.
tradeoffs.security: Public data; no secret-bearing client material implied.
tradeoffs.extensibility: Can be transformed into bounded mission fixtures while retaining source identity.
tradeoffs.performance: Dataset size requires selecting a bounded fixture rather than shipping the full corpus to the client.
material_reasons: Reusable source material exists, so bespoke corpus creation is not justified by default.
A bounded transformation still needs exact version and provenance before use.

probes.rationale: The architectural mismatch is already material and a local spike would require adopting a disproportionate LMS stack.

build_new_unmet_requirements: No searched full-coverage candidate provides the bounded interactive mission state machine without importing a substantially broader product architecture.
decision.rationale: Build only the narrow mission runtime while composing the existing learner-evidence system and reusing suitable dataset material.
residual_uncertainty: The first mobile interaction spike may expose a better fitting specialized runtime candidate.
reconsideration_triggers: A maintained full-coverage mission framework is identified with materially lower integration cost.
The selected reusable dataset cannot satisfy licensing or provenance constraints.
